name: Slidebean
tagline: Slidebean automatically designs pitch deck slides as users type their content, choosing the optimal layout for each slide type. It includes startup-focused templates for investor pitches and has been used by over 100,000 startups. Its pitch deck service pairs AI design with human designer review.
